hero.heading: Full VMs when you need them. A microVM for every app.
hero.lead: Run Windows, Home Assistant OS or OPNsense as full VMs, and every app in its own small VM with its own kernel. One console, one API, no YAML required.

capabilities.heading: Everything you run, in one list.

items.title: Full VMs
items.body: QEMU with KVM: UEFI, virtual TPM, Secure Boot and a VNC console in the browser. Windows 11 installs out of the box.

items.title: Apps in microVMs
items.body: Container images run inside Kata microVMs on Cloud Hypervisor, so each app gets its own kernel.

items.title: Shared mode
items.body: Set isolation: shared for a plain container with crun when memory is tight.

items.title: App catalog
items.body: One-click apps from curated and community templates, with sane defaults for storage and names.

items.title: Compose import
items.body: Paste a Compose file and get a Crustates app with volumes, secrets and HTTPS.

items.title: Passthrough
items.body: USB, whole disks and GPUs, including a shared iGPU for media transcoding.

items.title: Templates and cloud-init
items.body: Build a VM once, clone it many times and configure it on first boot.

items.title: Updates with rollback
items.body: See new image versions, update an app and roll back if the health check fails.

items.title: Logs, shell and secrets
items.body: Live logs and a shell for every app, with secrets injected as files or variables.

how.heading: Two engines, picked per workload.
how.lead: Crustates chooses the engine from what you ask for. You can always override it in the spec.

steps.title: You describe it
steps.body: A VM or App resource: image or ISO, CPU, memory, disks, network.

steps.title: The agent picks an engine
steps.body: Full VM → QEMU. App → Kata microVM. isolation: shared → crun.

steps.title: It reconciles
steps.body: The node agent creates, watches and heals the workload until it matches the spec.

ask.body: "Why did immich restart three times last night?" The assistant reads the app's events, logs and memory metrics and points at the cause.
ask.command: crust ask "why did immich restart last night?"

faq.title: Do I have to use microVMs?
faq.body: No. They are the default for apps because they are safer, but isolation: shared runs a plain container.

faq.title: Can I run Docker Compose apps?
faq.body: Yes. Import the Compose file; each service becomes part of a Crustates app.

faq.title: Does GPU passthrough work?
faq.body: Yes, for full VMs with QEMU. A shared iGPU can also be given to apps for transcoding.

faq.title: Why not Firecracker for everything?
faq.body: Firecracker has no GPU, USB or display support. It comes later for short-lived jobs.
